entities.summary: Pastor Taiwo Odubiyi (b. 1965-05-29, Abeokuta) was a author or novelist of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Abeokuta and Nigeria. Known in the fields of nigeria, authors & novelists, africa.
